description: This file defines the RedshiftEngineSpec class for integrating Amazon Redshift with the Superset data visualization platform. It includes methods for handling connection errors, normalizing table names, uploading data, and managing queries.

classes.name: RedshiftEngineSpec
classes.description: Engine specification class for Amazon Redshift, providing connection handling, error parsing, data upload, and query management functionalities.

methods.name: normalize_table_name_for_upload
methods.description: Normalizes table and schema names to lowercase as Redshift folds unquoted identifiers to lowercase.

methods.name: update_params_from_encrypted_extra
methods.description: Extracts and applies sensitive parameters from encrypted_extra, including handling IAM authentication for Redshift Serverless.

methods.name: df_to_sql
methods.description: Uploads a pandas DataFrame to Redshift, overriding data types to NVARCHAR(max) due to Redshift limitations.

methods.name: _mutate_label
methods.description: Converts labels to lowercase, as Redshift only supports lowercase column names and aliases.

methods.name: get_cancel_query_id
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID (PID) of the current query session for cancellation.

methods.name: cancel_query
methods.description: Cancels a running query in Redshift using the process ID.
